summary: M6 is not production-ready yet; local product evidence is strong, but external WeChat, production environment, recovery, customer finance sign-off, customer pilot, and handover evidence remain open.

checks.title: 全场景回归证据
checks.detail: M5 close gate and desktop/mobile main-flow plus role-workbench evidence are present.

checks.title: 性能与兼容压测
checks.detail: Local list/report/export performance evidence exists with p50/p95/error-rate and export timing; production-scale load evidence is still required.

checks.title: 浏览器与移动视口证据
checks.detail: Local Chrome desktop and 390px mobile viewport evidence is available; production device breadth remains open.

checks.title: 小程序产品端与真实 API 流
checks.detail: Native Store/Purchaser/Supplier mini-program role APIs pass the local HTTP flow check; real-device WeChat acceptance remains open.

checks.title: 微信小程序真机与订阅消息
checks.detail: Missing WECHAT_APP_ID/WECHAT_TEST_ACCOUNT and real-device evidence; do not claim mini-program readiness from Web evidence.

checks.title: 部署配置与生产环境
checks.detail: DATABASE_URL, PRIVATE_FILE_DIR, and PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL must point at production-grade services before launch.

checks.title: 对象存储与私有凭证策略
checks.detail: PRIVATE_FILE_DIR/object storage policy is not configured for production.

checks.title: 备份恢复与 RPO/RTO
checks.detail: Local database/private-file restore evidence exists; production drill must still prove RPO<=15 minutes and RTO<=4 hours.

checks.title: 发布、迁移与回滚手册
checks.detail: Local migration status, required release scripts, rollback runbook text, and rollback checklist evidence exist; production rehearsal is still required.

checks.title: 数据初始化与财务对平
checks.detail: Local initialization inventory and finance reconciliation checks pass; customer source files and finance sign-off are still required.

checks.title: 试运行与交接
checks.detail: Local pilot rehearsal evidence is complete; real customer pilot participants, handover, and sign-off are still required.
